info.title: TMS Requisition API - Password Reset
info.description: Public, unauthenticated email-OTP password reset flow extracted from the TMS Requisition API Postman collection. Consists of two steps: (1) Forgot Password requests a 6-digit OTP be emailed to the account's resolved address, (2) Reset Password verifies that OTP and sets a new password.

servers.description: Default base_url from the Postman collection

post.description:
Requests a 6-digit password reset OTP for the given user_name (acc_user_info.user_name, which is always an email in practice). Always returns the same generic 200 success message whether or not the account exists, deliberately, to avoid revealing which usernames/emails are registered. Callers should branch on the presence/absence of an `errors` object rather than the message text to detect failure; validation errors (e.g. missing user_name) still return a 422.

The OTP is emailed to the account's resolved address (os_employee.email_address, falling back to user_name if it's itself email-shaped) and expires after OTP_EXPIRY_MINUTES (default 10 minutes).

No rate-limit headers are returned on success, but repeated calls (>5/min) from the same client will get a 429 — this endpoint has its own scoped throttle, independent from Login's.

user_name.description: The account's username, which is always an email address in practice.

200.description: Generic success response, returned whether or not the account exists.

message.example: If an account matches, a password reset OTP has been sent.

422.description: Validation error, e.g. missing or malformed user_name.

429.description: Too many requests. This endpoint has its own scoped throttle (>5/min from the same client), independent from the Login endpoint's throttle.

post.summary: Complete password reset using an OTP
post.description:
Completes the reset: verifies otp_code against acc_user_info (must match user_name and be unexpired), then writes the new password (md5-hashed, matching this app's legacy hashing scheme) and clears the OTP fields. On success, any previously issued api_token for this account is also invalidated — the account's existing Login token stops working, so the client must call Login again afterwards to get a new one.

Requires a prior successful call to /forgot-password for the same user_name to generate a valid otp_code.

user_name.description: The same user_name used in the /forgot-password request.

otp_code.description: The 6-digit OTP emailed to the account (or read directly from acc_user_info.otp_code in dev environments where SMTP delivery is not configured).

200.description: Password reset successfully. Any previously issued api_token for this account is invalidated.

422.description: OTP is invalid/expired/mismatched, or validation error (e.g. password_confirmation mismatch, missing fields).

value.message: The OTP is invalid or has expired.

message.example: The OTP is invalid or has expired.

user_name: The user name field is required.
